name: Coalition Airstrikes — Hodeidah
detail: First Saudi-led coalition strikes on Houthi-held territory since the 2022 truce, targeting military capability linked to the shipping and refinery attacks; coalition said port itself was not targeted.

name: 14-Nation Red Sea Maritime Defence Coalition Launched
detail: Saudi Arabia convened 43 of 51 invited states plus the EU in Riyadh; 14 signed the founding statement to protect Bab el-Mandeb, Red Sea and Gulf of Aden shipping. UAE and Oman did not join.

name: Mecca Joint Defence Agreement Signed
detail: MBS, Erdoğan and Shehbaz Sharif signed a mutual-defense pact declaring an attack on any signatory an attack on all three, combining Pakistani nuclear deterrence, Turkish military-industrial capacity and Saudi finance.

name: Coalition Airstrikes — Sana'a & Hodeidah
detail: Reciprocal coalition strikes on Houthi military sites after the announced strikes on a Saudi ship and the Jazan refinery; coalition reiterated Hodeidah port was not targeted.

name: Yemen National Defense Council Raises Readiness
detail: Yemen's National Defense Council raised military readiness and approved a permanent session; government forces conducted 100+ operations against Houthi positions in 24 hours.

name: Yemeni Army Counter-Offensive, South of Marib
detail: Yemeni Army claimed a 'successful operation' against Houthi positions south of Marib; outcome not independently verified.
